user.title: Sungrow inverter
user.description: The dongle's Modbus port is encrypted by the inverter itself and needs no login. The rule runs as soon as this is saved. It only ever changes the inverter's feed-in limit while the trigger is hit, and puts back the value it found.

data.trigger_price: Trigger price (limit export while the price is below)
data.min_sun_elevation: Stop limiting below this sun elevation
data.restore_after_minutes: Put the original limit back after

data_description.price_entity: The sensor holding the price you are paid to export. A negative value means you pay to export.
data_description.trigger_price: In the sensor's own unit. 0 limits export only while the price is negative.
data_description.max_export_kw: The limit written while the trigger is hit. 0 stops export entirely. A limit already at or below this is left alone.
data_description.min_sun_elevation: Puts the original limit back before the light ends and the dongle powers off.
data_description.restore_after_minutes: A limit this integration lowered is put back to the value it found, unless the rule renews it.
data_description.min_interval_seconds: Stops the limit flapping on a noisy price.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the inverter through the dongle.
